newsitem.title: USA: National Media stock falls on loss warning.
newsitem.headline: National Media stock falls on loss warning.

text.p: The stock of National Media Corp. fell sharply Friday, a day after the producer of television "infomercials" said it expected to report a loss of up to $5 million in the current quarter.
The stock fell $2, or 25 percent, to $6 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-afternoon.
The Philadelphia-based company said it expected to return to profitability in the fourth quarter.
National Media said Thursday the loss of 16 cents per fully diluted share for the third quarter ending Dec. 31 was principally a result of a downturn in its U.S. business.
The company said its international business continued to be profitable during the same period, though its Japanese business was off.
The company also said Brian McAdams will step down as chairman and as an officer of the company at the end of the year.
Ira Lubert, a managing director of TL Ventures, a venture capital fund, and a member of the National Media board of directors, will serve as interim chairman.
